patches.name: Account switcher private mode
patches.description: Lets you choose whether the account switcher offers Anonymous Browsing or Incognito, even with one account. Choose in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Always show Hide
patches.description: Keeps the Hide option in the post menu on Home, even when Reddit swaps it for recommendation options. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: AutoModerator comments
patches.description: Collapses or hides comments from u/AutoModerator. Choose in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Collapse all comments
patches.description: Adds a button next to the comment count on a post that collapses or expands all comments. Choose what it collapses in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Colorize comment indent lines
patches.description: Gives each reply level in a comment thread its own line colour. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Content-type filter
patches.description: Show only videos, images, text or link posts on Home and Popular.

patches.name: Create button in communities
patches.description: Adds a Create post button to the top bar of each community. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Disable bottom bar auto-hide
patches.description: Keeps the bottom navigation bar visible while scrolling. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Disable home feed auto-refresh
patches.description: Stops the home feed from reloading and jumping to the top when you come back to the app. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Disable refresh on back to exit
patches.description: Pressing back on the home feed exits without scrolling to the top and reloading. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Download all from gallery
patches.description: Tapping Download on a gallery post asks whether to save just the current item or every item in the gallery.

patches.name: Feed auto-scroll
patches.description: Adds a play button to the navigation bar that slowly scrolls the feed on screen. Speed is set in bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Full-screen reply
patches.description: Opens replies in the older full-screen editor that shows the comment you're replying to, so you can select and quote its text. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom navigation bar (the side rail on tablets) into a floating see-through capsule. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Home feed tabs
patches.description: Adds swipeable For You, Following and Popular tabs to the home feed. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Post side panel
patches.description: On tablets in landscape, opens posts in a panel on the right while the feed stays visible. Can be turned off in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Same-subreddit full-screen media
patches.description: Lets full-screen videos and images show only posts from the subreddit you opened. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: See-through status bar
patches.description: Lets the home feed scroll up under the status bar, fading into it. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Share post content
patches.description: App shortcuts and "Share via…" in the share sheet send the post's image, video or text instead of its link.

patches.name: Swipe up for comments
patches.description: In the full-screen video player, swiping up opens the comments and the next video is a sideways swipe away. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Tablet grid feed
patches.description: Shows the feed as a grid with 2 or 3 columns on tablets and other wide screens. Phones are unchanged.

patches.name: Video playback speed
patches.description: Adds Reddit's playback speed controls to the full-screen video player. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.
